title: Relative $P$-Ideals of Hypergraphs and Ultrafilter Spectra
summary: We study ideals of hypergraphs of finite uniformity under countable upper bounds modulo finite vertex covers. The canonical ideal generated by a free filter and finite weak colorings has this relative $P$-property exactly when the filter is the intersection of finitely many $P$-points. The classification is preserved by adjoining hypergraphs that are locally finite after a finite vertex deletion.
